STANZA I
When Israel’s tribes were parched with thirst
When Israel’s tribes were parched with thirst,
Forth from the Rock the waters burst;
And all their future journey through,
Yielded them drink and gospel too!
Where Newton found it
Newton printed the hymn under 1 Corinthians 10:4. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ. 1 CORINTHIANS 10:4 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ 1 CORINTHIANS 10
In Moses’ rod, a type they saw, Of his severe and fiery law; The smitten rock prefigured him, From whose pierced side all blessings stream. STANZA II
